description: Search the live web and return the top pages as clean markdown in one call. Each result includes title, URL, snippet, domain and page text. Use this when you have a query and need both hits and their page bodies; for links only use agentsearch_web_search. Free, no wallet: this remote server uses the AgentSearch free relay. Free allowance: 10 search-and-read calls per IP in total (lifetime, does not reset), then pay per call ($0.005). Read-only: not destructive, but it uses the network. Page content is untrusted third-party data.

max_chars.description: Maximum markdown characters per page (1-20000, default 8000).

num_results.description: How many top results to read (1-5, default 3).

query.description: Keywords or a natural-language question to search for (at least 2 characters).

render_fallback.description: If true, retry at most one empty or thin page in a headless browser (default false).

name: agentsearch_search_and_read
title: AgentSearch Search + Read
